la-hefferon.title: Jim Hefferon, Linear Algebra, open textbook, University of Vermont
la-hefferon.notes: Elementary systems, subspaces, bases, transformations, least squares, determinants and duals. Author-hosted free textbook.

la-axler-fourth.title: Sheldon Axler, Linear Algebra Done Right, fourth edition, Springer (2024)
la-axler-fourth.notes: Finite-dimensional spaces, operators, eigenvalues, inner products, singular values and multilinear algebra. Fourth edition freely available.

la-mit-1806sc.title: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.06SC, Linear Algebra (Gilbert Strang, Fall 2011)
la-mit-1806sc.notes: Elementary elimination, matrix factorization, projections, eigenvectors, SVD and computational examples.

la-bott-tu.title: Raoul Bott and Loring Tu, Differential Forms in Algebraic Topology (1982)
la-bott-tu.notes: Exterior algebra and differential forms as multilinear measurements.

la-mit-jordan.title: Gilbert Strang, MIT OpenCourseWare 18.06, Lecture 28: Similar matrices and Jordan form
la-mit-jordan.notes: Similarity and Jordan form, with a lecture video and course context.

la-mit-exponential.title: Gilbert Strang, MIT OpenCourseWare 18.06, Lecture 23: Differential equations and exp(At)
la-mit-exponential.notes: Matrix exponential power series and constant-coefficient linear differential equations.

la-trefethen-bau.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen and David Bau III, Numerical Linear Algebra, SIAM (1997; 25th Anniversary Edition 2022)
la-trefethen-bau.notes: QR, Householder reflections, conditioning, stability, LU, SVD, and rank-aware linear algebra.

la-higham-accuracy.title: Nicholas J. Higham, Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, second edition, SIAM (2002)
la-higham-accuracy.notes: Rounding-error models, stability, pivoting, backward error and iterative refinement.

la-demmel-applied.title: James W. Demmel, Applied Numerical Linear Algebra, SIAM (1997)
la-demmel-applied.notes: Numerical matrix factorization, least squares, conditioning, SVD and rank-revealing algorithms.
